Name: Improved Pet Area (Content Patcher Edition)
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: A simple mod that improves your pet area on the farm.
Description:
Ever feel bad that your dog or cat is stuck with a little bit of half rotten wood for a bed?  Get annoyed that they don't have a food dish to go with that water bowl?  This mod fixes both of those problems, by sprucing up the wood planks, adding a cushion for your pet to lie on, and adding a magical food bowl that converts water into pet food.

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) to work and should work with any custom maps you may have (however, please let me know if you find it does not).

WORKS WITH SDV 1.4!

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].

4.  Run the game using SMAPI.
